editorial_note: Original writing informed by community discussions about both recognisable traits and tired stereotypes. These are creative sign-level lines, not personal natal-chart readings.

one_liners: I need a minute. I accidentally felt everything.
Half in this world, still meeting the deadline.
Softness is not the same thing as access.
My imagination has better production value than reality.
I saw the potential. Reality filed an objection.
My playlist understood before I did.
I disappeared to process one emotion and found twelve more.
Romantic soul, increasingly practical blocking skills.
I read the room and needed a nap afterward.
affirmations_predictions: A creative idea becomes real once you give it a schedule.
The relationship meant for you will respect both your tenderness and your limits.
You will hear your own intuition more clearly after the noise settles.
A dream you dismissed returns with one practical next step.
You can care about someone's potential without volunteering to rescue it.
Your sensitivity will guide a choice that logic alone could not finish.
A gentle routine helps your imagination produce something tangible.
The next connection feels deep without requiring confusion.
micro_poems: then return them to the sea;
you call it learning to breathe.
the ocean keeps no straight lines,
your sleep is full of doorways,
when it is dreamed by you.
